The engine's shape

fBase_c is the root of everything — and note that dScene_c and dView_c are siblings of dActor_c, not descendants. Nothing at that level is actor-specific, which is why the tree's name for it (ActorBase) misleads.

fBase_c                      1 direct,  337 below
  dBase_c                      6 direct,  336 below
    dActor_c                    95 direct,  287 below
    dScene_c                    10 direct,   42 below
    dView_c                      1 direct,    1 below

How to read a name

The names are structured. A domain letter, a subsystem, sometimes a two-letter course code, then Japanese romaji describing what the thing is.

Domain letter

tokenmeaningconfidenceevidence
dgame layerhighThe bulk of the engine. dBase_c sits directly under fBase_c.
fframework layerhighfBase_c is the root of everything, including scenes and cameras, not just actors.
mlibrary / middlewarehighOnly mHeap::Heap_t and its two children appear in this ROM's RTTI.
cshared, non-game-specificmediumSeen only on the cMgSmartball_* family in ov006.
